methods.name: CRLMDG-LM (Causal representation learning-guided multi-target domain generalization network)
methods.summary: A network combining causal representation learning with Mamba for fine-grained landslide mapping. It features a multi-scale fusion feed-forward attention Mamba network (MFFAM-Net) with GSFA and MCSCIA modules, and a causal representation learning multi-target domain generalization (CRLMDG) strategy using FFT-based data augmentation and contrastive loss to learn domain-invariant features.
methods.verbatim: we propose a causal representation learning-guided multi-target domain generalization network for fine-grained landslide mapping from high-resolution RSI (CRLMDG-LM)... Data will be made available on request.

reproducibility_assessment: The landslide inventory (HRSIDGLM) is not linked, and the custom code for CRLMDG-LM is not available, with the authors stating it will be provided only upon request.
